onboarding.s0_desc: This quick guide will walk you through everything you need to know to get the most from the Padel Intelligence Platform.
onboarding.s1_desc: The home page gives you an overview of your assigned reports, key metrics, and quick access links to your most important dashboards.
onboarding.s2_desc: Access all your Power BI reports directly from the sidebar. Each report is tailored to your role and data access level.
onboarding.s3_desc: The Overview dashboard provides a 360° view of your club's performance — revenue, attendance, satisfaction, and more.
onboarding.s4_desc: Use filters within each report to drill down into specific time periods, categories, or segments. Changes apply instantly.
onboarding.s5_desc: Track daily club operations, court utilization, booking statistics, and staff performance in real time.
onboarding.s6_desc: Monitor sponsorship ROI, partner visibility metrics, and contract performance across all active partnerships.
onboarding.s7_desc: Track your club's sustainability commitments, environmental impact, and social responsibility indicators.
onboarding.s8_desc: Our machine learning section provides predictive insights — coming soon — including player performance forecasts and revenue predictions.
onboarding.s9_desc: Time-series models will predict your next quarter's revenue based on historical trends and seasonal patterns.
onboarding.s10_desc: Advanced segmentation and classification models will help identify high-value players and optimize engagement strategies.
onboarding.s11_desc: Stay informed with real-time notifications about privilege changes, system events, and important updates — visible in the top bar.
onboarding.s12_desc: Visit your profile page to update your name, change your password, and manage your email address.
onboarding.s13_desc: Click your avatar on the profile page to upload a photo. Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WebP.
onboarding.s14_desc: Change your password anytime from the Profile page. Use a strong password with uppercase letters, numbers, and symbols.
onboarding.s15_desc: Admins can create, edit, and delete users from the Admin → Users page. Assign roles and manage access levels.
onboarding.s16_desc: Roles control which dashboards each user can access. Admins can configure permissions per role from Admin → Roles.
onboarding.s17_desc: Admins can add or edit dashboards and paste the Power BI embed URL from Admin → BI Dashboards.
onboarding.s18_desc: Configure your SMTP server from Admin → Email Settings to enable password reset and notification emails.
onboarding.s19_desc: Switch between French and English at any time using the FR / EN buttons in the top navigation bar.
onboarding.s20_desc: Toggle between dark and light mode using the moon/sun icon in the top navigation bar. Your preference is saved.
onboarding.s21_desc: Admin pages require re-entering your password for security. The session stays active for 30 minutes.
onboarding.s22_desc: AppPI is built for the International Padel Federation to centralize business intelligence across all affiliated clubs.
onboarding.s23_desc: Your data is secured with JWT authentication, role-based access control, and audit logging for all admin actions.
onboarding.s24_desc: Contact your system administrator for access issues or reach the AppPI support team for platform questions.
onboarding.s25_desc: You now know everything to get started. Click 'Get Started' to explore your dashboards. You can re-open this guide from your profile menu.
